name: gap_vwap_momentum_trifecta_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY and BANKNIFTY gap at the open when overnight FII/DII order imbalances hit the market. During the first 90 minutes, institutional VWAP execution desks running gap-direction orders treat the session VWAP as their execution benchmark — they defend it actively by absorbing counter-trend flow whenever price approaches it. When the index pulls back to VWAP after a gap-up (or rallies to VWAP after a gap-down) and the 5-second bar closes back in the gap direction, multiple algorithmic VWAP desks simultaneously recognize the same support/resistance and accelerate their fills, compressing what takes 15-60 minutes on individual stocks into a 30-90 second burst on the index.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Daily gap size and direction. No scaling needed — this is a DAILY measure. Gap threshold 0.3% is kept from original because NIFTY/BANKNIFTY gap of 0.3% (e.g. 22 pts on NIFTY at 24000) is large enough to attract institutional VWAP execution desk interest but small enough to produce a VWAP pullback within 90 minutes.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset per session
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP — cumulative from 09:15, reset daily. No lookback scaling needed; VWAP is by definition cumulative and not period-based. Institutional desks use this exact calculation as their execution benchmark, making it a self-reinforcing support/resistance level.

indicators.name: vwap_touch
indicators.formula: State flag: True if low <= vwap*(1+thr) for gap-up, or high >= vwap*(1-thr) for gap-down; thr=0.05%
indicators.purpose: Detects when price has approached VWAP closely enough to trigger VWAP-desk absorption. Touch threshold 0.05% of VWAP (e.g. 12 pts on NIFTY at 24000) is tighter than the original (which checked if bar touched VWAP via high/low) because 5-second bars are much smaller and a true VWAP touch is a candle whose low comes within 12 pts of VWAP — not merely below it.

indicators.name: mom_6
indicators.purpose: 30-second momentum to confirm bounce direction at the 5-second trigger bar. Original used return_from_open (a much longer context filter). Here we use a 6-bar (30s) momentum as a trade TRIGGER — it must be positive for gap-up bounce and negative for gap-down rejection — because at 5-second resolution we need a fast confirmation that the VWAP recross has velocity behind it, not just a noise touch.

conditions: vwap_touch == True for current day (price pulled back to within touch_threshold of VWAP)
close[i] > vwap AND close[i-1] <= vwap — bar just crossed ABOVE VWAP
mom_6 > 0 — 30-second momentum is positive (bounce has velocity)
buy_ce.confirmation: 5-second bar closes above VWAP after a day with gap-up opening, with 30-second upward momentum

conditions: vwap_touch == True for current day (price bounced up to within touch_threshold of VWAP)
close[i] < vwap AND close[i-1] >= vwap — bar just crossed BELOW VWAP
mom_6 < 0 — 30-second momentum is negative (rejection has velocity)
buy_pe.confirmation: 5-second bar closes below VWAP after a day with gap-down opening, with 30-second downward momentum

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 spot pts on NIFTY at delta 0.5. After a valid VWAP bounce, if NIFTY retreats 10 spot pts back below VWAP the thesis is invalidated — VWAP desks did not absorb effectively. NIFTY 30-second typical move is 2-5 spot pts, so 10 pts is roughly 2-3 typical bars of adverse move — enough conviction to cut.
exit.target_rationale: 9 option pts = ~18 spot pts on NIFTY at delta 0.5. VWAP bounce first legs on NIFTY extend 20-35 spot points when institutional VWAP desks are actively buying. Targeting 18 pts captures roughly 60-80% of the expected first leg while allowing an exit before the bounce stalls (1:1.8 R:R vs 5 pt stop).
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 11:30 — gap trades lose relevance after first 2h when price has fully digested the overnight information

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — above 22 VWAP desks are replaced by fear-driven flow that ignores VWAP anchors
filters.time_filter: entry 09:20-11:30 IST only; gap information decays after 2h as new intraday news dominates
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume on 5-second bars is noisy; VWAP itself incorporates volume weighting
filters.trend_filter: gap direction is the session bias; no additional trend filter needed
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — as VWAP algos become more prevalent, the bounce becomes faster and more efficient; 5-second entry captures this better than 1-minute did

adaptation_notes: Original ran on top 25 Nifty50 stocks at 1-minute bars with 15-60 minute holds. Three key changes: (1) Universe → NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index directly — the original stock universe is just a proxy for index-level institutional flow, and the index itself is cleaner. (2) Hold time compressed from 15-60 min to 30-120s — on the index, VWAP bounce momentum is absorbed by competing algorithms within 2 minutes, not 60; entering at 5-second resolution means we catch the first 30-60 seconds of the move before mean-reversion kicks in. (3) Momentum indicator replaced from return_from_open (multi-hour) to mom_6 (30-second) — the original's first-hour momentum was a context filter (is the trend intact?); at 5-second resolution we already know the trend from gap_dir, so we use a fast momentum as the entry trigger instead.
weaknesses: Signal frequency is low — 3-factor confluence (gap + VWAP touch + bounce) occurs 1-3 times per day on average; max_trades_per_day=4 is rarely hit
First day of trading (no prev_day_close available) produces no signals
On large gap days (>1%), price may not pull back to VWAP within the 11:30 cutoff — missed signals
BANKNIFTY is more volatile; 5 pt stop may be too tight on high-VIX days despite the VIX<22 filter
